IC1: Is not of reproductive potential, or is of reproductive potential and agrees to avoid becoming pregnant or impregnating a partner while receiving trial medication or within 6 months after the last dose of trial medication
IC2: Has chronic back pain of =3 months duration by history
IC3: Has physician-diagnosed active nr-axSpA with disease duration <= 5 years
IC6: • Enthesitis (heel) physician-diagnosed (spontaneous pain [OR] or tenderness at examination of the site of the insertion of the Achilles tendon [OR] or plantar fascia)
IC9: • History of physician-diagnosed inflammatory bowel disease (IBD)
IC10: • History of uveitis confirmed by an ophthalmologist
IC11: • Good response [AND] to nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID)
IC12: • Family history of SpA (presence of ankylosing spondylitis [OR], psoriasis [OR], acute uveitis [OR], reactive arthritis [OR], or IBD)
IC15: Has a HLA-B27+ gene and 2 or more of the SpA characteristics listed above
IC16: Has elevated CRP [OR] at Screening or evidence of active inflammation [AND] in the sacroiliac joints on MRI
IC18: Shows high disease activity [AND] at Screening and Baseline of both a Total Back Pain score of =4 and a Bath Ankylosing Spondylitis Disease Activity Index (BASDAI) score of >= 4
IC19: Has an acceptable history of NSAID use
IC20: Has [NOT] no history of untreated latent [OR] or active tuberculosis (TB) prior to Screening
IC21: Has had no recent close contact with a person with active TB or, if there has been such contact, will undergo additional evaluations and receive appropriate treatment for latent TB
